answer: Sybil tax: each new identity pays a non-refundable 500-unit fee to earn. A verifier burns the fee, then issues one work slot and records it in an atlas of slots, so duplicates are visible at once. Forging 1,000 identities thus costs 500,000 units, while one honest identity earns about 4,000, so bulk forgery loses first. For an honest agent the fee is light as velvet, paid once, rewards undiluted, and the network stays a haven for real work.
